from pathlib import Path
import re,json,sys
from urllib.parse import unquote
paths=['CHANGELOG.md','benchmarks/agentic/REPORT-20260820-sonnet5-saturation.md','docs/10-prompt/README.md','docs/10-prompt/项目负责人工作契约.md','docs/plans/2026-09-05-001-next-phase-optimization-program-plan.md','docs/plans/2026-09-05-002-next-phase-development-sequence.md','docs/plans/2026-09-11-spec-runtime-setup-p123-optimization-plan.md','docs/plans/2026-09-18-001-project-lead-cycle-1-plan.md','docs/strategic-review/README.md','docs/项目审查/2026-07-06-skill-prompt-精简优化方案.md','docs/项目审查/2026-07-06-真实状态与提升优先级.md','docs/validation/project-lead-cycle-1/2026-09-18-cycle-1-execution-evidence.md','docs/validation/project-lead-cycle-1/2026-09-20-evaluation-and-market-follow-through.md']
errors=[]; checked=0; skipped=0
for path in paths:
 text=Path(path).read_text(); text=re.sub(r'(?ms)^\x60{3}.*?^\x60{3}[^\n]*','',text)
 refs=re.findall(r'!?\[[^\]\n]*\]\(\s*(<[^>\n]+>|[^\s)]+)(?:\s+["\'][^"\']*["\'])?\s*\)',text)
 refs+=re.findall(r'(?m)^\s*\[[^\]]+\]:\s*(\S+)',text)
 for ref in refs:
  ref=ref.strip('<>'); target=unquote(ref.split('#',1)[0])
  if not target or re.match(r'^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.-]*:',target) or target.startswith('/'):
   skipped+=1;continue
  checked+=1; p=Path(path).parent/target
  if not p.exists(): errors.append({'source':path,'target':ref})
print(json.dumps({'status':'passed' if not errors else 'failed','markdown_files':len(paths),'relative_targets_checked':checked,'external_anchor_or_absolute_skipped':skipped,'errors':errors,'scope':paths,'limitations':['校验Markdown常见内联和引用式相对目标存在性；不验证远端URL、锚点、渲染或历史内容准确性。','包括本轮未跟踪交付文档；不覆盖其他并行任务新计划。']},ensure_ascii=False))
sys.exit(bool(errors))
